info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Servicing Order Cancellation-spec
info.description: The Servicing Order Cancellation API allows businesses to efficiently process cancellations for servicing orders. By utilizing this API, service providers can submit cancellation requests for specific orders, ensuring that updates reflect in real-time. Typical consumers include customer support teams and order management systems that need to manage order statuses effectively. This API streamlines the cancellation process, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a specific servicing order identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). It processes the cancellation request and returns the cancellation status.
